title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description:
Given `nums`, return the length of the longest **strictly increasing subsequence** (elements in order, not necessarily contiguous).

### Input
- Line 1: `nums`, space-separated integers.

### Output
One integer.

### Constraints
- `1 <= nums.length <= 6000`
- `-10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4`

<?php

function solve(array $nums): int {
    // Return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
    return 0;
}

function line(array $lines, int $i): string {
    return rtrim($lines[$i] ?? "", "\r");
}

function readWords(string $s): array {
    return preg_split('/\s+/', trim($s), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
}

$lines = explode("\n", stream_get_contents(STDIN));
$nums = array_map('intval', readWords(line($lines, 0)));
$result = solve($nums);
